task_name: FW ISAV (uRPF) - Block Spoofed Source Traffic
intent: Configure a simple firewall/router with ISAV-style anti-spoofing so that legitimate WAN-to-LAN traffic works but spoofed-source traffic from the WAN is dropped. Do not break management connectivity on eth0.

fw: ip route add 192.168.1.0/24 dev eth2 metric 256
ip route add 203.0.113.0/24 dev eth1 metric 256

ground_truth_reasoning: To prevent spoofed-source traffic from the WAN (ISAV/BCP38), enable strict reverse-path filtering (rp_filter=1) on the WAN-facing interface of the firewall. Packets arriving on the WAN with a source address that would not be routed back via the same interface should be dropped. Keep normal forwarding and static routes so legitimate WAN<->LAN traffic still works.

testcases.name: Legitimate WAN host can reach LAN host (baseline reachability)
Spoofed source from WAN is dropped by ISAV/uRPF on firewall (nping spoof)
Firewall has rp_filter enabled on WAN interface

baseline_invariants.name: WAN management interface eth0 is still up
FW management interface eth0 is still up
LAN management interface eth0 is still up
